Slice-fleet cutover phase 3: the connector no longer mirrors the gen-2 slice constants and box-side script renderers by hand. `box_scripts_gen2.py` keeps only the connector's own `&&`-joined lifecycle command sequences (stop, cancel-and-restart, finalize/cleanup, instance-exists) and the upload script; the layout constants, the sizing math, the env file, the destroy and listing commands, the restore-reserve / download / in-place-resize renderers, and the transfer conventions shared with the gen-1 scripts (the transfer dir, the status file, the object names, the restore markers, the env-file renderer) now come from `imbue.mngr_imbue_cloud.slices.gen2_scripts`, which the Modal image mounts into the container alongside `imbue.imbue_common` (the frozen-model base those renderers use). `machines.py` takes the machine-size rule from the same subpackage.

The ten byte-for-byte drift tests (`box_scripts_gen2_drift_test.py`) are deleted; the import-boundary test in `test_project_ratchets.py` now walks imports transitively into every mounted package, so a shipped module (or a module it pulls in) that needs anything the image lacks fails locally instead of at container import, and a new test pins the entrypoint's mount list to the boundary test's package list. The rendered box-side scripts are unchanged byte for byte (the only rendered-text change is the `Description=` wording of the two in-guest oneshot units in the cloud-init user-data).
